items.exampleEn: Cut the sandwich into two triangles for the children.
items.exampleZh: 把三明治切成兩個三角形給孩子們。

items.exampleEn: The candles gave a dim, warm light.
items.exampleZh: 蠟燭發出昏暗而溫暖的光。

items.exampleEn: You look fabulous in that blue jacket!
items.exampleZh: 你穿那件藍色外套真好看！

items.exampleEn: The new phone is technically better than the old one.
items.exampleZh: 這支新手機在技術上比舊的好。

items.exampleEn: Many party hats are shaped like cones.
items.exampleZh: 很多派對帽都是圓錐形的。

items.exampleEn: Some sea animals have almost transparent bodies.
items.exampleZh: 有些海洋動物的身體幾乎是透明的。

items.exampleEn: The plan sounded absurd at first, but it worked.
items.exampleZh: 那個計畫一開始聽起來很荒謬，但成功了。

items.exampleEn: The mighty king ruled the land for forty years.
items.exampleZh: 那位強大的國王統治這片土地四十年。

items.sentenceEn: The meeting room was so dim that we turned on all the lights.
items.sentenceZh: 會議室太暗了，所以我們把燈全打開。

items.audioEn: Put a traffic cone next to the hole so nobody falls in.
items.audioZh: 在洞旁邊放一個三角錐，免得有人掉進去。
items.questionZh: 為什麼要在洞旁邊放三角錐？
options: To keep people safe from the hole

items.sentenceEn: Technically, tomatoes are fruit, not vegetables.
items.sentenceZh: 嚴格來說，番茄是水果，不是蔬菜。

items.sentenceEn: The mighty river runs through three countries before reaching the sea.
items.sentenceZh: 那條大河流經三個國家後才入海。

items.stemEn: The window is made of ____ plastic, so you can see what's inside the box.
items.stemZh: 盒子的窗是用透明塑膠做的，所以你看得到裡面有什麼。

items.stemEn: A ____ has three sides and three corners.
items.stemZh: 三角形有三個邊和三個角。

items.passageEn: On Saturday, my nephew and I spent the afternoon at the beach. He wanted to build a mighty castle, so we used a plastic cup and a paper cone to make the towers. One tower had a triangle on top like a roof, and we carved windows into the walls with a stick. Later, we bought ice cream cones from a tiny shop with transparent walls. Technically, the shop was already closed, but the owner sold us two cones anyway. In the evening, the light became dim, and we walked home. My nephew said it was a fabulous day. Of course, the idea of a sand castle that lasts forever is absurd: the sea took it away by morning.
items.passageZh: 星期六，我和外甥在海灘玩了一下午。他想蓋一座雄偉的城堡，所以我們用一個塑膠杯和一個紙做的圓錐來做塔。有一座塔頂有個像屋頂一樣的三角形，我們還用樹枝在牆上刻出窗戶。後來，我們在一家牆是透明的小店買了甜筒冰淇淋。嚴格來說，那家店已經打烊了，但老闆還是賣了兩支甜筒給我們。傍晚光線變暗了，我們就走路回家。外甥說今天真是棒極了。當然，想要一座永遠不倒的沙堡是很荒謬的：到了早上，海水就把它沖走了。

questions.questionZh: 他們用什麼做出城堡的塔？
options: 從家裡帶來的木頭模型
在店裡買的一套沙灘玩具

questions.questionZh: 那家小店有什麼特別的地方？
options: 老闆是作者以前的國中同班同學
其實已經打烊卻還賣冰給他們

items.promptZh: 說他十分鐘能跑完十公里，實在太荒謬了。
referenceEn: It is absurd to say that he can run ten kilometers in ten minutes.
Saying he can run ten kilometers in ten minutes is absurd.
rubricZh: absurd 可用在 It is absurd to… 或 be 動詞後（例如 It is absurd to say…、… is absurd 等）
時態配合內容（例如 is、was 等）

items.promptZh: 我們去年夏天在海邊度過了一個很棒的假期。
referenceEn: We had a fabulous holiday at the beach last summer.
Last summer, we had a fabulous vacation by the sea.
rubricZh: fabulous 可放名詞前或 be 動詞後（例如 a fabulous holiday、was fabulous 等）
「假期」可寫，例如 holiday、vacation 等；「海邊」可寫，例如 at the beach、by the sea 等
用過去式（例如 had、spent 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：單字卡釋義不涵蓋例句詞義：例句 "Pine cones fell from the trees" 的 cone 是「毬果（松果）」，釋義「圓錐（體）；甜筒；三角錐」完全沒有這一義，第一義也對不上（裁示 27、28）。建議換例句示範圓錐／甜筒（例如 "The party hats were shaped like cones."），或釋義加「毬果」並放第一。
